transport.shippedAuthResult: HTTP 401 with the project TYPESAFE_API_KEY (measured, 641ms to failure)
transport.measuredEndpoint: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-latest (the endpoint the P3 JevHttpClient uses)
transport.note: globalThis.fetch was intercepted to forward the identical {state, questions} payload to the working endpoint and translate the reply back into the gateway response schema. Everything above the socket is the shipped code path: jevStructureComposer -> experimental_composeSpec -> composeBatch. One deviation: the shim does not forward init.signal, so the evaluator 10s timeout was not wired to the real request. No effect on successful-run timings; it would matter only for an abort test.

apiShape.strategy: batch (default for a new tree: options.initialSpec is undefined and strategy is unset)
apiShape.evaluatorRoundTripsPerCompose: exactly 2 — one "select" call, then one "layout" call; 1 when the selection short-circuits
apiShape.eventSequence: step(after select) -> step(after layout) -> complete; composeSpec is NOT incremental per element
apiShape.shortCircuit: selected.length === 1, or === 2 with a single-slot root, yields complete immediately after the first step (1 round trip)
apiShape.adapterMapping: jevStructureComposer maps type==='step' to status 'partial' and type==='complete'+stopReason==='finish' to 'complete'; it drops steps[] and inputTokens, so cost is invisible to callers
silentFailureModes: stopReason 'unavailable' yields spec: null, which `if (!event.spec) continue` swallows — the generator ends with zero events and no error (repo CLAUDE.md constraint 5)
stopReason 'limit' is mapped to status 'partial', so no 'complete' ever arrives and the caller cannot distinguish it from a still-streaming compose

pools.B: 15 candidates — device-realistic pool sized like a real generated surface (adds Row, Alert, repeated ListItem/Rule, Metric, Badge, Progress, Slider, ButtonGroup, 2 Buttons)

idle15s.note: pool A, 8 composes, 15s of idle between each. The server sends no Keep-Alive header; undici drops the idle socket, so every compose pays connection setup again.
